# `ProxyMode`

The proxy mode for the FreeRdp connection


## Type

```csharp
RoyalApps.Community.FreeRdp.WinForms.Configuration.ProxyMode
```

## Used By

- [ProxyConfiguration](/api/reference/royalapps-community-freerdp-winforms-configuration-proxyconfiguration)

[View source](https://github.com/royalapplications/royalapps-community-freerdp/blob/main/src/RoyalApps.Community.FreeRdp.WinForms/Configuration/ProxyMode.cs#L6)

## Values

### `None = 0`


No proxy will be used (default)


### `HTTP = 1`


Use HTTP proxy


### `SOCKS5 = 2`


Use SOCKS5 proxy
